placeResult.name: La Capitana Surquillo
placeResult.description: ✨ La Capitana – Peruvian flavor with a young soul At La Capitana, we celebrate classic Peruvian criolla cuisine, and we dare to take it to the next level. Here you’ll find those dishes that feel like home – but with a modern, creative, and delicious twist. Our menu is full of Peruvian classics with personality: fresh market ingredients, thoughtful techniques, and that special touch that makes every visit feel new. We’re a restaurant with a young spirit, where the food is great, the service is warm, and the vibe is always good. Perfect for flavorful lunches, stylish dinners, or simply treating yourself — just because you deserve it. Come see why so many say that at La Capitana… the food is in charge.
